The '''Delephr system''' was located in the [[Carrion sector/Legends|Carrion sector]], a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was connected by the [[Relgim Run/Legends|Relgim Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Gelda system/Legends|Gelda]] and [[Ord Thoden system/Legends|Ord Thoden systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Delephr system was the origin point of the [[Delephran]] social group.<ref name="Blasters" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> It fell within the borders of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], and was a part of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] between [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]] and [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Delephr system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square J-4.<ref name="TEA" />
